children: When economic uncertainty looms and stock valuations look stretched, it is crucial for investors to find reliable ways to protect their portfolios. Pivoting toward defensive assets like utility stocks is a proven strategy to safeguard capital while collecting recurring cash flow. Because households and businesses rely on electricity, gas, and essential infrastructure regardless of the economic climate, utility companies generate predictable earnings even during market downturns.
If you want to add stability and dependable dividend income to your portfolio, an excellent exchange-traded fund (ETF) to consider is the
Global X Equal Weight Canadian Utilities Index ETF

. This year, the fund is up 12%, delivering strong capital appreciation alongside its defensive appeal. It also yields 3.4%, which is an attractive payout for investors prioritizing steady income and capital preservation.

The passively managed ETF tracks an equal-weighted index of major Canadian utility services companies, ensuring that no single stock dominates the portfolio. Its holdings feature some of the country's most reliable dividend payers, including
. Because these businesses operate largely regulated assets, their cash flows remain remarkably stable over the long haul.

A major bonus for income-focused investors is that the Global X Equal Weight Canadian Utilities Index ETF distributes payments every month rather than quarterly, currently paying $0.08 per unit. With a management fee of 0.25% and a management expense ratio of 0.35%, this fund offers a straightforward, low-maintenance way to collect monthly cash flow while keeping your portfolio anchored in safe, time-tested Canadian utility leaders.

title: Income Investors: Seek Safety in This High-Yielding Utilities ETF
